tasks.IdentifyLeftMostItemColor: Determine the color of the left-most item from a given list.

answer: The exact arrangement of the items on the desk is: 1. An orange pen, 2. A turquoise pair of sunglasses, 3. A gold scrunchiephone charger, 4. A yellow envelope, 5. A fuchsia bracelet. The left-most item is the orange pen, so its color is (B) orange.
